items.markdown:
You must submit the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) online **within 3 days (72 hours) prior to your arrival date**.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/content/thailand-digital-arrival-card-tdac-required-from-1?cate=5d6636c215e39c3bd0006cb7) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/content/thailand-digital-arrival-card-tdac-required-from-1?cate=5d6636c215e39c3bd0006cb7)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UCMKjUwbvew&vl=en&t=23)

Submit your details for free on the Official Thai Immigration Bureau Portal.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/content/thailand-digital-arrival-card-tdac-required-from-1?cate=5d6636c215e39c3bd0006cb7) [[1]](https://sydney.thaiembassy.org/en/content/thailand-digital-arrival-card-tdac)

Once submitted, you will receive a QR code via email. Be sure to save it to your phone or print it out to show alongside your passport when you pass through Thai immigration.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1egildlfVmo) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1egildlfVmo)[[2]](https://www.travelcenter.uk/blog/thailand-goes-digital-the-new-digital-arrival-card/)[[3]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/thailand-digital-arrival-card-tdac/)[[4]](https://www.exotravel.com/blog/en/thailand-digital-arrival-card/)

expanded_element.description: All travelers must submit a Singapore Arrival Card electronically at least 3 days before entering Singapore.
